 The Daily Beast Updated Thu, October 22, 2026 at 9:06 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Democratic rising star Abdul El-Sayed has blown up at his Republican opponent in a fiery midterm election debate. In the final sprint toward an election that could help flip control of the upper chamber, El-Sayed squared up in Detroit against former Republican congressman Mike Rogers. Less than two weeks before Election Day, polls show a neck-and-neck contest in Michigan to replace retiring Democratic Sen. Gary Peters.
